race.comment: FACE THE WILD (12) was backed off the map to win her maiden second up here, sent out $1.55 and justifying the support with a solid win after tackling a much stronger race first up. Better again for that and can go on with the job. MASKED MARAUDER (1) struggled second up here but had been good fresh and back to 1000m down in grade should suit much better. If Will Gordon can hold leader's back he'll be hard to hold out. CICCONI RAIN (7) is coming off a maiden win at Swan Hill at her third start. Tougher now but was too speedy there and can give a sight again. I'M HELRO (10) could be an improver back to 1000m which looks her best trip off what we've seen so far.
